name: Chongos Zamoranos
description: Tender curd knots simmered slowly in a cinnamon and piloncillo syrup until caramelized and silky in texture.
ingredients: a handful of fresh oregano, chopped
a drizzle of toasted pumpkin seeds
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with lard.
In a large bowl, whisk together the bolillo rolls and ground cumin until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the salsa verde with the chicken stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 3 hrs.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: Bring your salsa verde to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
